prayerExcerpt.en-US: With what excess of goodness does God communicate Himself to souls that open themselves to Him!
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Com que excesso de bondade se comunica Deus às almas que a Ele se abrem!

meta.face: A Phrygian of about thirty, BEARDLESS, with a warm light-brown Anatolian complexion and a WIDE, FLAT-PLANED face — broad, HIGH cheekbones set wide, a BROAD, low-bridged nose, VERY WIDE-SET dark almond eyes under straight, thick black brows, a WIDE mouth with full lips in a small, grateful smile, a SQUARE chin with a small cleft; short, tight black curls close to the head; the gaze lifted, full of hope.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book's engraving shows him as a young, beardless man in a belted tunic holding a scroll, and the card follows it; the Painter's Manual lists him among the Seventy simply as 'vieillard', an old man, which the card sets aside for the book's picture of the letter-bearer. Colossae in the Lycus valley below Mount Cadmus was Philemon's city (book, Wikipedia).
